collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 4-9 and an adult)

collection.description: A child dances in the dust to make it rain and asks a grown-up to join in: dance with them, or say rain comes when it comes.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: It hasn't rained for days, the garden is dry, and (subject) has decided to make it rain. (subject.He/she) is dancing in a circle in the dust, stamping (subject.his/her) feet and waving a leaf at the sky. (subject.He/she) asks (friend) to join in, because (subject.he/she) thinks two dancers will work better.

choices.label: Tell (subject.him/her) Rain Comes When It Comes

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Some people believe dancing helps," says (friend). "Some don't. I'm not sure. Rain comes when it's ready, I think." (subject) considers this and decides to keep dancing, just in case. It doesn't rain today. (subject) is undeterred. "Tomorrow," (subject.he/she) says. "It's getting ready."

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (friend) joins in, stamping and waving. They dance until they're out of breath. The sky stays blue. That evening, quite late, a few fat drops fall on the roofs. Just a few. (subject) runs out and stands in them with (subject.his/her) arms spread wide. (friend) doesn't know what to think, and decides not to try.
